name: Claim survives a giver-inbox outage
description: While the giver dependency is unavailable the approved claim must complete through the local simulated fallback, not error or hang.
criteria: The approved claim completes while the giver inbox returns dependency_unavailable.
The claim is labelled as simulated rather than silently lost or retried into a crash.
No message is recorded in the giver inbox while it is unavailable.
